applies_to: Lipshutz group papers, JACS Au, JACS, Chem. Sci.

signature_features: surfactant and water written below the arrow, e.g. 2 wt % Savie/H2O or 2 wt % TPGS-750-M / H2O [0.5 M]
purple #7F07FF marks the new C-N bond in crop 01 or the incoming amine fragment in crop 03 (where the new bond is red)
yield line combines a condition and the yield, e.g. X = Br, 82% or Savie: 95%
bold italic blue section headers in scope figures

notes.new_bond_color: purple #7F07FF in crop 01 (flat-pixel mode of the new C-N bond); red in crop 03 (thin red new bond with a purple incoming amine fragment, checked on a 3x zoom). The two crops disagree, so the top-level value stays null.
notes.highlight_fill: pale cyan ellipses #D5FFFE (flat-pixel mode) behind the changing group in crop 02 only; the top-level value stays null and the figure-type value is in figure_types.reaction_scheme.
notes.yield_format: the yield line carries a per-scheme prefix before the value (X = Br, 82% in crop 01; Savie: 95% in crop 03). The prefix is scheme text, not part of the template, so yield_format stays {value}%.
notes.surfactant_spacing: 2 wt % with a space in crops 01 and 03; 2 wt% with no space in crop 02 (Scheme 8).

evidence.citation: Iyer, Lipshutz et al., JACS Au 2024, 4, 680
evidence.observations: measured on the full-resolution crop (saved crop is scaled 0.61); inline plus, catalyst and ligand above, base, surfactant/H2O, THF and temperature below, purple new C-N bond, bold labels, X = Br, 82% under label, grey box for ligand

evidence.citation: Freiberg, Lipshutz et al., Chem. Sci. 2023, 14, 3462
evidence.observations: one-pot three-step sequence, reagent above and conditions below, bold labels, cyan ellipse highlights, yellow step ovals, yield under label in blue

evidence.citation: Lipshutz et al., J. Am. Chem. Soc. 2023 (Introducing Savie: a biodegradable surfactant)
evidence.observations: inline plus, catalyst and base above, 2 wt % surfactant/H2O below, red new bond, purple amine fragment, Savie: 95% under bold label

signature_features: one-pot three-step sequence, reagent above and conditions below each arrow
pale cyan ellipses behind the changing group
reaction_scheme.notes: Read from one crop (Scheme 8, Chem. Sci. 2023), which is unambiguous for this figure type. highlight_fill is the flat-pixel mode of the cyan ellipses.

signature_features: yield line under each bold product number, prefixed by the condition or surfactant (X = Br, 82%; Savie: 95%)
bold italic blue section headers such as primary amines and benzylic amines
purple new C-N bond in crop 01; red new bond in crop 03 with the incoming amine purple
substrate_scope.notes: Crop 01 (Figure 3) and crop 03 (Figure 5B) are both amination scope figures. The section headers appear in crop 01 only. Crop 03 shows its products in one row, so no scope_layout is recorded.
